Vežbe 04 - Preobučavanje neuralne mreže¶

Učitavanje neophodnih biblioteka¶

In [1]:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

from keras.models import Sequential
from keras.layers import Input, Dense

from keras.callbacks import EarlyStopping
from keras.regularizers import l2

from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, classification_report

Učitavanje podataka¶

In [2]:
data = pd.read_csv('podaciCas04.csv', sep=';')

ulaz = data.drop(columns='d')
izlaz = data.d

klase = np.unique(izlaz)

K1 = ulaz[izlaz == klase[0]]
K2 = ulaz[izlaz == klase[1]]
K3 = ulaz[izlaz == klase[2]]

plt.figure()
plt.plot(K1.x1, K1.x2, 'o')
plt.plot(K2.x1, K2.x2, '*')
plt.plot(K3.x1, K3.x2, 'd')
plt.show()
In [3]:
Nk = len(klase)
izlazOH = np.zeros((izlaz.size, Nk))
izlazOH[izlaz == klase[0], 0] = 1
izlazOH[izlaz == klase[1], 1] = 1
izlazOH[izlaz == klase[2], 2] = 1

Podela na trening, test i validacioni skup¶

In [4]:
ulazTrening, ulazTest, izlazTreningOH, izlazTestOH = train_test_split(ulaz, 
                                                                      izlazOH, 
                                                                      test_size=0.2,
                                                                      random_state=42)
                                                          
ulazTrening, ulazVal, izlazTreningOH, izlazValOH = train_test_split(ulazTrening, 
                                                                    izlazTreningOH, 
                                                                    train_size=0.8, 
                                                                    random_state=42)

Kreiranje i obučavanje modela¶

In [19]:
def make_model(ulaz, izlaz):
    model = Sequential()
    model.add(Input(shape=(np.shape(ulaz)[1],)))
    model.add(Dense(200, activation='relu')) 
    model.add(Dense(100, activation='relu')) 
    model.add(Dense(50, activation='relu'))
    model.add(Dense(izlaz.shape[1], activation='softmax'))

    model.compile(optimizer='adam', 
                  loss='categorical_crossentropy', 
                  metrics=['accuracy']) 
    
    return model
In [6]:
model = make_model(ulazTrening, izlazTreningOH)
 
history = model.fit(ulazTrening, izlazTreningOH, 
                    epochs=1000,
                    batch_size=64, 
                    validation_data=(ulazVal, izlazValOH), 
                    verbose=0,
                   )

plt.figure()
plt.plot(history.history['loss'])
plt.plot(history.history['val_loss'])
plt.show()

Provera performansi modela¶

In [7]:
def model_perf(ulaz, izlaz, model):
    izlazPred = model.predict(ulaz, verbose=0)
    izlazPred = np.argmax(izlazPred, axis=1)
    izlaz = np.argmax(izlaz, axis=1)
    acc = accuracy_score(izlaz, izlazPred)
    cr = classification_report(izlaz, izlazPred)

    print(f'\n {cr}')

    return acc

Ntest = 200
x = np.linspace(-4, 7, Ntest)
y = np.linspace(-4, 7, Ntest)
Xgrid, Ygrid = np.meshgrid(x, y)
Xgrid = Xgrid.reshape((1, Ntest**2))
Ygrid = Ygrid.reshape((1, Ntest**2))

grid = np.append(Xgrid, Ygrid, axis=0).T
Ypred =  np.argmax(model.predict(grid, verbose=0), axis=1)
        
K1pred = grid[Ypred==klase[0], :]
K2pred = grid[Ypred==klase[1], :]  
K3pred = grid[Ypred==klase[2], :] 

plt.figure(figsize=(10,5))
plt.subplot(1,2,1)
plt.plot(K1pred[:, 0], K1pred[:, 1], 'r.', alpha=0.05)
plt.plot(K2pred[:, 0], K2pred[:, 1], 'b.', alpha=0.05)
plt.plot(K3pred[:, 0], K3pred[:, 1], 'g.', alpha=0.05)
plt.plot(K1.x1, K1.x2, 'ro')
plt.plot(K2.x1, K2.x2, 'b*')
plt.plot(K3.x1, K3.x2, 'gd')
plt.title('Normalan prikaz')

plt.subplot(1,2,2)
plt.plot(K1pred[:, 0], K1pred[:, 1], 'r.', alpha=0.5)
plt.plot(K2pred[:, 0], K2pred[:, 1], 'b.', alpha=0.5)
plt.plot(K3pred[:, 0], K3pred[:, 1], 'g.', alpha=0.5)
plt.plot(K1.x1, K1.x2, 'ro')
plt.plot(K2.x1, K2.x2, 'b*')
plt.plot(K3.x1, K3.x2, 'gd')
plt.xlim(0, 2)
plt.ylim(1, 3)
plt.title('Uvecani prikaz')

plt.show()

model = make_model(ulazTrening, izlazTreningOH)

es = EarlyStopping(monitor='val_loss', mode='min', patience=20, verbose=1, restore_best_weights=True)
history = model.fit(ulazTrening, izlazTreningOH, 
                    epochs=1000, 
                    batch_size=64, 
                    validation_data=(ulazVal, izlazValOH), 
                    callbacks=[es],
                    verbose=0,
                   )

plt.figure()
plt.plot(history.history['loss'])
plt.plot(history.history['val_loss'])
plt.show()

Regularizacija¶

In [13]:
def make_model(ulaz, izlaz):
    model = Sequential()
    model.add(Input(shape=(np.shape(ulaz)[1],)))
    model.add(Dense(200, activation='relu', kernel_regularizer=l2(1e-3))) 
    model.add(Dense(100, activation='relu', kernel_regularizer=l2(1e-3))) 
    model.add(Dense(50, activation='relu', kernel_regularizer=l2(1e-3)))
    model.add(Dense(izlaz.shape[1], activation='softmax'))

    model.compile(optimizer='adam', 
                  loss='categorical_crossentropy', 
                  metrics=['accuracy']) 
    
    return model
